name: core.openwop.connections.microsoft365
description: Microsoft 365 connection pack — OAuth2 provider for Teams, Outlook (Mail/Calendar), and SharePoint via the Microsoft Graph API. DEPLOY-GATED. Reach is `openapi` against the Microsoft Graph OpenAPI surface: Microsoft's first-party remote MCP servers are per-tenant/preview (a tenant-templated URL, not a single global https endpoint the manifest can fix), so a stable Graph OpenAPI path is the honest day-1 reach (capability honesty). Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the OAuth client id/secret host-side.
